profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Boeing | CompTIA Security+

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Served as scrum master for 3 years, facilitating daily scrums, sprint demos, backlog refinements, and PI plannings, while coordinating cross-team collaboration and program-level communication
- Supported containerization of TT&C software using Podman and Red Hat OpenShift across two  teams, including service distribution, configuration, dependency integration, and testing
- Designed a C++ inheritance model for receivers subscribing to and processing messages from the  C2MS bus, reducing code duplication and accelerating future development time and code reuse
- Translated MATLAB algorithms into C++ and developed corresponding automated test suites  using C++ and Robot Framework to verify compliance with software requirements
- Developed a C++ health and status message publisher to retrieve measurands from a database  and publish them to the GMSEC bus, configurable via external configuration files
- Developed and updated command and telemetry tables using Python to validate software  communication with a satellite, via transmission of commands and reception of telemetry
- Designed and maintained architecture diagrams in Cameo to represent and support multiple  mission capabilities across the program

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed loopback test code for built-in test module for a receiver
- Developed a receiver supporting test and fault modes with associated test/fault code
- Developed multiple test procedures and scripts for system qualification and validation

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Implemented anti-spoofing algorithm for a GPS receiver
- Developed software to test registers and handle error checking
- Developed multiple scripts and conducted loopback and regression testing for a receiver

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Created use cases, build procedures, instruction documents, and design documents
- Added functionality to Formal Qualification Testing GUI, created scripts, and performed regression and loopback testing
